rows.title: Every germinal products page carries the same service chrome as a live animals page, resolved inside its own set
rows.detail: Germinal products is a sibling set of live animals in the animals frontend, mounted at /germinal-products with its own journey, routes and services. A trader moving between the two sets should see one service, so every germinal page must carry the same chrome as the page it is copied from: the 'Import notification service' service navigation with the same items in the same order, the Alpha phase banner, the footer, the browser-title pattern, section captions, back links, the error summary and banners. The parts of the chrome that are scoped to a set must resolve inside the germinal set rather than falling back to live animals: the service name and the Dashboard item go to the germinal set's own root, Dashboard stays the current item everywhere inside a germinal notification, and an error on an address under the germinal set is shown in the germinal set's chrome. The shared layout already resolves these from the request's mount prefix, so this is proof that the new set picks them up, not a change to the shared layout.
acceptanceCriteria: Every germinal products page shows the 'Import notification service' service navigation with the same items, in the same order, as a live animals page (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-006, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-009; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p1-006, repo-frontend-p1-010)

Every germinal products page shows the Alpha phase banner with its feedback link, and the footer, as live animals pages do (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-006; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p1-006)

Every germinal products page's browser title reads '<page title> - Import notification service - GOV.UK', with 'Error: ' in front when the page shows validation errors (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-006; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p1-001)

Germinal products journey pages show the same section captions, back links, error summary and banners as the live animals page each one is copied from (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-009, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-011)

On every germinal products page the service name and the Dashboard navigation item link to the germinal products set's own root at /germinal-products, and following either one lands there (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-008; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-103; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p1-006, repo-frontend-p1-010; conflicts:c-314)

Dashboard is the current navigation item at the germinal products set's root and on every page inside a germinal products notification (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p1-011; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-011)

Opening an address under the germinal products set that does not exist shows 'Page not found' in the germinal set's chrome, with the service name linking to the germinal products set's own root (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p1-048-m1; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p1-098; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-008)

rows.notes: Not a slice that stands apart: none of this chrome can be observed until the germinal products set is mounted and its first page exists, and it needs the same set, gateway and mount as the set's first row. existingRow inc-176 already holds req-1907 with criteria that say the same thing; the combiner keeps inc-176's id, theme (germinal-products), repos, gate and externalDependsOn and merges these criteria with the ones already there rather than making a second row. The repos and dependsOn given here are inc-176's so the draft stands on its own; inc-176's dependency on inc-130 existed only for an event field a later ruling withdrew, so it is left out. c-314 overrules the morning ruling's redirect of a set root to a notification list in the front door, so no criterion here hands the trader on to another service; the germinal list that the set root renders is another row's to build, and the criterion about the service name and Dashboard links is observable before it lands, from where the links go. The shared layout, the set-scoped paths and the error chrome already resolve per set (the service navigation block, dashboardPath, inDashboardSection, setIdForPath), so this row should change no shared file; if the plan finds one must change, that is a journey-foundation change, and journey-foundation has split off, so it would go to that branch. The germinal set's own service-navigation fit spec is a copy inside the set folder: the live animals one belongs to the split-off type-question-and-templates theme and is not edited here.

rows.title: The performance suite's readiness probe follows the front door home's new main heading
rows.detail: The performance suite will not start a run until the stack is functionally ready, and it judges the front door ready by opening its home signed in and matching the main heading exactly. When the home's main heading becomes 'Import notification service', the probe has to change in the same increment: changed first it breaks every run on the main branch, and changed late every run's readiness fails after five minutes. The address book probe and the rule that the stack is ready only when every probe has passed once both stay as they are. The heading itself belongs to the front door's overall home, which is held until the front door dashboard's requirements are agreed, so this waits with it.
acceptanceCriteria: The performance suite's 'INS signed-in page' readiness probe passes when the front door's home answers 200 to a signed-in trader with the main heading 'Import notification service' (repo:perftests repo-perftests-p2-040; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-075, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-076; conflicts:c-146)
The 'address book read' readiness probe still passes only when the front door's address book answers 200 with the heading 'Address book' (repo:perftests repo-perftests-p2-041)

The stack counts as functionally ready only when one pass succeeds for all six readiness probes, and readiness otherwise fails after 300 seconds naming the probes that failed (repo:perftests repo-perftests-p2-042)
openQuestions: Blocked: the front door home's 'Import notification service' main heading names the overall home, which the 9 October afternoon ruling holds as front-door dashboard summary information until its requirements firm up and are agreed (c-146). Who: whoever owns the front door dashboard's requirements must firm them up and agree them with the product owner, after which the dashboard area is re-distilled; until then the probe keeps the heading it matches today.
The probe changes only in the increment that changes the heading: changing it first breaks every performance run on the main branch, so it never stands apart.
rows.notes: Not a slice that stands apart: the probe matches the heading exactly, so the probe and the heading change together or every run breaks. existingRow inc-128 already holds req-1905 with the heading change and with these three readiness criteria; the combiner keeps it there, in the ins-dashboard theme, with perftests last in that row's repos, and does not make a second row. The repos given here are inc-128's so the draft stands on its own; this draft's own code is the readiness script in the performance-tests repo, which no theme split off early touches. For the combiner: the heading change itself sits in the front door's dashboard feature template and copy, which the split-off type-question-and-templates theme now touches, and the suite also checks the home's heading in its front-door script, which the split-off address-book theme touches; both are the dashboard area's and the combiner's to settle when inc-128 is re-distilled, and neither is this row's own code. The six-probe rule and the 300-second timeout are read from the readiness script and the suite's smoke config; neither needs editing for this change.
